overview.text: Edgar González, Jr. is the Democratic state representative for the 23rd District, serving as an Assistant Majority Leader and Floor Whip. He was raised in Chicago's Little Village, attended Chicago Public Schools, and graduated from Harvard University. He previously worked as a constituent services staffer for U.S. Rep. Jesús "Chuy" García. His campaign says he supports affordable healthcare, defending abortion rights, and investing in education and infrastructure to create jobs. He sponsored a bill to authorize regulated online casino games.
